# File Handling Prompts

File operation hygiene: clean diffs, portable paths, safe writes, and formats left unbroken.

**25 prompts.** Install the whole category bundle:

```
Please fetch https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bentheautomator/free_ai_prompts_that_dont_suck/main/install/file-handling.md and append its contents to my project instructions file.
```

| Prompt | Severity | What It Solves | Install |
|--------|----------|----------------|---------|
| [Extract Archives Safely](extract-archives-safely.md) | critical | Stops archive extraction from writing outside the target via zip-slip paths | [install](../../install/extract-archives-safely.md) |
| [Don't Clobber Files with Shell Redirection](dont-clobber-with-redirection.md) | high | Stops a stray > from truncating a file you were still composing or reading | [install](../../install/dont-clobber-with-redirection.md) |
| [Don't Mangle File Encodings](dont-mangle-encodings.md) | high | Keeps edits from adding BOMs or turning non-ASCII text into mojibake | [install](../../install/dont-mangle-encodings.md) |
| [Edit Sources, Not Build Outputs](edit-sources-not-build-outputs.md) | high | Stops fixes from landing in dist/ and minified bundles the next build deletes | [install](../../install/edit-sources-not-build-outputs.md) |
